claude.rationale: gap_45=0 because the oil-and-gas operating assets (T4) and their production/operational processes (T5) were retained together by the reorganized entities rather than separated — "operating assets, processes and key employees were retained intact" with operations "substantially uninterrupted." gap_56=0 because the processes moved coherently alongside the workforce and management, evidenced by the management incentive plan reserving ≥10% of new common stock for retained officers/employees, so people/culture (T6) aligned with T5 at closing. T1=replace since existing equity was cancelled and control passed from unitholders to former creditors; T3=swap because new equity of "a new entity, the form of which shall be determined" was issued (a re-domiciled legal vehicle) with Berry separated under its own plan.

gemini.rationale: The slice explicitly states that the oil and natural gas exploration-and-production operations (T4/T5) were retained by the reorganized entities and continued substantially uninterrupted. Furthermore, the operating workforce and management (T6) were retained alongside the operations, meaning no structural gaps occurred between product, process, and people.
